note: Each input MUST be rejected by a conforming implementation. It MUST NOT produce a seal. The 'reason' explains which rule is violated.

vectors.name: required_field_null
vectors.reason: Required sealed fields (label, value, context, source_url) MUST be non-null strings.

vectors.name: required_field_missing
vectors.description: A required field (context) is omitted entirely.
vectors.reason: Required sealed fields MUST be present. An omitted required field is invalid.

vectors.name: nullable_field_omitted
vectors.description: A nullable field (unit) is omitted rather than present as literal null.
vectors.reason: Nullable fields (unit, time_period) MUST be present as literal null when they do not apply, never omitted. Omission would produce a shorter object and a different hash.

vectors.name: string_null_in_nullable
vectors.description: The string "null" appears where a real null or a real value is required.
vectors.reason: The string "null" MUST be rejected and never treated as a real null (the BigQuery/Apps Script ghost). Upstream must convert it to a real null before sealing.

vectors.name: string_null_in_required
vectors.description: The string "null" as a required field value.
vectors.reason: The string "null" MUST be rejected wherever it appears, to avoid a real-null vs string-null ambiguity.
